title: Law No. 15.123/2025 increasing the penalty for psychological violence against women committed with AI
title_original: Lei nº 15.123, de 24 de abril de 2025 – Altera o art. 147-B do Código Penal para estabelecer causa de aumento de pena no crime de violência psicológica contra a mulher quando praticado com o uso de inteligência artificial
summary: Federal law of 24 April 2025 that amends Article 147-B of the Penal Code, which defines the crime of psychological violence against women. It adds a sole paragraph raising the penalty by half when the crime is committed using artificial intelligence or any other technology that alters the victim's image or voice, targeting deepfake-based abuse. The law took effect on its date of publication.
key_obligations: Penalty raised by half when psychological violence uses AI to alter a woman's image or voice
